statements.text: The preliminary circular orbit shall have period $$orbit_period_s$$ at altitude $$altitude_km$$, using Earth radius $$earthRadius_km$$ and gravitational parameter $$gravitationalParameter_km3_s2$$.
statements.condition: (((((altitude_km > 0) and (earthRadius_km > 0)) and (gravitationalParameter_km3_s2 > 0)) and (orbit_period_s > 0)) and (orbit_period_s == ((2 * math.pi) * math.sqrt((((earthRadius_km + altitude_km) ** 3) / gravitationalParameter_km3_s2)))))

statements.text: The preliminary circular orbit at altitude $$altitude_km$$ shall provide $$sunlight_s$$ of sunlight and $$eclipse_s$$ of eclipse per $$orbit_period_s$$ orbit, using Earth radius $$earthRadius_km$$ and horizon angle $$horizon_angle_rad$$.
statements.condition: (((((((((altitude_km > 0) and (earthRadius_km > 0)) and (orbit_period_s > 0)) and (sunlight_s > 0)) and (eclipse_s > 0)) and (horizon_angle_rad == math.acos((earthRadius_km / (earthRadius_km + altitude_km))))) and (sunlight_s == ((0.5 + (horizon_angle_rad / math.pi)) * orbit_period_s))) and (eclipse_s == ((0.5 - (horizon_angle_rad / math.pi)) * orbit_period_s))) and (abs(((sunlight_s + eclipse_s) - orbit_period_s)) <= (1e-9 * orbit_period_s)))

statements.text: The positive sunlight and eclipse periods shall sum to $$orbit_period_s$$ within numerical tolerance.
statements.condition: ((((orbit_period_s > 0) and (sunlight_s > 0)) and (eclipse_s > 0)) and (abs(((sunlight_s + eclipse_s) - orbit_period_s)) <= (1e-9 * orbit_period_s)))

statements.text: The preliminary load budget shall allocate $$sunlight_energy_J$$ during $$sunlight_s$$ of sunlight and $$eclipse_energy_J$$ during $$eclipse_s$$ of eclipse.
statements.condition: ((((((((((sunlight_power_W >= 0) and (eclipse_power_W >= 0)) and (sunlight_duty >= 0)) and (sunlight_duty <= 1)) and (eclipse_duty >= 0)) and (eclipse_duty <= 1)) and (sunlight_s > 0)) and (eclipse_s > 0)) and (sunlight_energy_J == ((sunlight_power_W * sunlight_duty) * sunlight_s))) and (eclipse_energy_J == ((eclipse_power_W * eclipse_duty) * eclipse_s)))

statements.text: The solar panels shall provide at least $$panel_min_W$$ at the declared source boundary.
statements.condition: ((((((((sunlight_energy_J >= 0) and (eclipse_energy_J >= 0)) and (sunlight_s > 0)) and (sunlight_efficiency > 0)) and (sunlight_efficiency <= 1)) and (eclipse_efficiency > 0)) and (eclipse_efficiency <= 1)) and (panel_min_W == (((sunlight_energy_J / sunlight_efficiency) + (eclipse_energy_J / eclipse_efficiency)) / sunlight_s)))

statements.text: The selected solar cell shall provide EOL maximum power $$cell_eol_W$$ from maximum power point voltage $$cell_eol_V$$ and current $$cell_eol_A$$.
statements.condition: (((cell_eol_V > 0) and (cell_eol_A > 0)) and (cell_eol_W == (cell_eol_V * cell_eol_A)))

statements.text: The array shall install $$installed_cells$$, at least the minimum $$minimum_cells$$ obtained by rounding calculated count $$required_cells$$ upward.
statements.condition: ((((((panel_min_W >= 0) and (cell_eol_W > 0)) and (required_cells == (panel_min_W / cell_eol_W))) and (minimum_cells == (- math.floor((- required_cells))))) and (installed_cells > 0)) and (installed_cells >= minimum_cells))

statements.text: For one nominal cycle per orbit, the battery shall support at least $$required_cycles$$ over $$lifetime_years$$, using $$days_per_year$$ and $$orbits_per_day$$ derived from period $$orbit_period_s$$.
statements.condition: (((((orbit_period_s > 0) and (lifetime_years > 0)) and (days_per_year > 0)) and (orbits_per_day == (86400 / orbit_period_s))) and (required_cycles == ((lifetime_years * days_per_year) * orbits_per_day)))

statements.text: The selected maximum depth of discharge $$dod_max$$ shall support $$supported_cycles$$, at least the required $$required_cycles$$.
statements.condition: (((((((((((required_cycles > 0) and (cycle_a > 0)) and (cycle_b < 0)) and (fit_dod_min > 0)) and (fit_dod_min <= fit_dod_max)) and (fit_dod_max <= 1)) and (dod_max >= fit_dod_min)) and (dod_max <= fit_dod_max)) and (dod_cycle_limit == ((required_cycles / cycle_a) ** (1 / cycle_b)))) and (supported_cycles == (cycle_a * (dod_max ** cycle_b)))) and (supported_cycles >= required_cycles))

statements.text: The battery shall provide at least $$battery_min_J$$ of BOL energy for eclipse demand $$eclipse_energy_J$$ at maximum DoD $$dod_max$$ and degradation margin $$degradation_margin$$.
statements.condition: (((((((((((((((eclipse_energy_J >= 0) and (dod_max > 0)) and (dod_max <= 1)) and (degradation_margin >= 0)) and (battery_min_J == ((eclipse_energy_J / dod_max) * (1 + degradation_margin)))) and (required_cycles > 0)) and (cycle_a > 0)) and (cycle_b < 0)) and (fit_dod_min > 0)) and (fit_dod_min <= fit_dod_max)) and (fit_dod_max <= 1)) and (dod_max >= fit_dod_min)) and (dod_max <= fit_dod_max)) and (supported_cycles == (cycle_a * (dod_max ** cycle_b)))) and (supported_cycles >= required_cycles))

statements.text: The selected battery shall have BOL energy $$pack_bol_J$$, at least the preliminary minimum $$battery_min_J$$.
statements.condition: ((((((battery_min_J >= 0) and (pack_bol_J > 0)) and (pack_bol_J >= battery_min_J)) and (retained_energy_factor > 0)) and (retained_energy_factor <= 1)) and (pack_eol_J == (retained_energy_factor * pack_bol_J)))

statements.text: EPS-02. The solar arrays shall provide at least $$panel_min_W$$ of average source power from $$sunlight_generation_J$$ over $$sunlight_s$$ of sunlight at each section's attainable DET or MPPT operating point under applicable illumination and EOL conditions.
EPS-08. The battery pack BOL energy $$pack_bol_J$$ shall meet minimum energy $$battery_min_J$$ from preliminary battery sizing.
EPS-09. For nominal operation, the battery pack shall support $$supported_cycles$$, at least the required $$required_cycles$$ at the selected DoD and applicable conditions.
EPS-11. The EPS shall replenish the battery from starting energy $$energy_start_J$$ and charge based SOC $$soc_start$$ over every specified nominal repeating interval.
EPS-19. Total EPS mass $$mass_kg$$ shall remain within allocation $$mass_allocation_kg$$.
EPS-21. Each software execution host shall provide $$required_data_bytes$$ of data memory within an allocation of $$available_data_bytes$$.
Sunlight path efficiency $$sunlight_efficiency$$ and eclipse path efficiency $$eclipse_efficiency$$ shall lie in (0,1].
statements.condition: ((((sunlight_efficiency > 0) and (sunlight_efficiency <= 1)) and (eclipse_efficiency > 0)) and (eclipse_efficiency <= 1))

statements.text: Maximum DoD $$dod_max$$ shall lie in (0,1] and the sourced fit interval [$$fit_dod_min$$,$$fit_dod_max$$] for power law coefficients $$cycle_a$$ and $$cycle_b$$.
statements.condition: (((((((cycle_a > 0) and (cycle_b < 0)) and (fit_dod_min > 0)) and (fit_dod_min <= fit_dod_max)) and (fit_dod_max <= 1)) and (dod_max >= fit_dod_min)) and (dod_max <= fit_dod_max))

statements.text: Maximum DoD $$dod_max$$ shall not exceed fitted cycle limit $$dod_cycle_limit$$.
statements.condition: ((((dod_max > 0) and (dod_max <= 1)) and (dod_cycle_limit > 0)) and (dod_max <= dod_cycle_limit))

statements.text: Battery EOL energy $$pack_eol_J$$ shall equal BOL energy $$pack_bol_J$$ multiplied by retained energy factor $$retained_energy_factor$$ in (0,1].
statements.condition: ((((pack_bol_J > 0) and (retained_energy_factor > 0)) and (retained_energy_factor <= 1)) and (pack_eol_J == (retained_energy_factor * pack_bol_J)))

statements.text: EPS-47. Nominal cycle DoD $$nominal_dod$$ shall not exceed maximum DoD $$dod_max$$.
EPS-52. Ending energy $$energy_end_J$$ shall be at least starting energy $$energy_start_J$$ minus nonnegative numerical closure tolerance $$closure_tolerance_J$$ over each nominal repeating interval.
EPS-53. Ending charge based SOC $$soc_end$$ shall be at least starting SOC $$soc_start$$ over each nominal repeating interval.
EPS-78. Occupied EPS volume $$volume_m3$$ shall remain within allocation $$volume_allocation_m3$$.
EPS-88. Each software execution host shall provide $$required_program_bytes$$ of program storage within an allocation of $$available_program_bytes$$.
EPS-89. The sum of each allocated task's execution time divided by its period shall give required utilization $$required_utilization$$, at most allocation $$allocated_utilization$$.
